content: The best friend is the man who in wishing me well wishes it for my sake alone.
author: Aristotle
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

In Aristotle's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life needs your unconditional support or appreciation today without any transaction?
